entries.note: Page opened. Per cubic metre for Huon pine craft logs or pieces, depending on grain and birds-eye. Not a slab price and not a competitive auction. A slab of about 2 m x 0.3 m x 0.05 m is about 0.03 m3, so roughly $33 to $130 at that raw rate; retail milled and dressed slabs sell for more. Labelled ASKING to keep it from setting a maximum.

searches_tried: Local comps.py (pipeline and work versions) with 'huon pine slab', 'huon pine', 'huon slab': Gowans hits only (paid locally), about 640 sold single slab/piece lots, median about $55; one non-Gowans guide (Island Specialty Timbers). WebSearch budget was used up, so no web searches were possible. Direct fetch of Island Specialty Timbers tender archive worked; timberbits and Gumtree returned 404/403. No open-market SOLD or UNSOLD comp for a Huon pine slab found. eBay sold listings (Huon pine slab, live edge) and Australian timber dealers would settle resale. Do not rely on the $200-500 resale guess in the scan notes: it is unsupported by any price seen.
chrome_hint: eBay Australia, sold and completed items: 'huon pine slab' and 'huon pine live edge', Australia only, last 90 days; also Gumtree and Tasmanian timber dealer pages for Huon pine slab asking prices.
viewing_check: Check the end grain for tight growth rings and the pale yellow colour; scratch or sand a small spot and smell it for the Huon pine oil aroma; measure length, width and thickness; check how far the crack runs and whether it goes right through; note whether it is dry or green and any rot, borer or splits at the ends.
